board_snapshot.note: Mutable board snapshot recorded at read time; provenance only, never a gate or a result.

boundary.public_c_boundary: not used: task-local harness over the vendored speex/speex_resampler.h boundary

canonical_report.format: canonical JSON: sort_keys=True, compact separators, allow_nan=False, one trailing newline

gates.reason: All stimuli are analytic or seeded; no paired transcript, speaker or language holdout exists.
gates.reopen: Freeze a permitted paired speech cohort with a transcript policy and independent scorer.

gates.reason: No real music, real room noise or rights-qualified silence recording was used.
gates.reopen: Freeze a rights-qualified music/silence cohort and a separate non-speech acceptance rule.

gates.reason: No listener panel, blind score sheet or perceived-pitch/quality judgment exists.
gates.reopen: Run authorized blind listening with consent, frozen items and independent review.

gates.reason: Only a caller-clock FIFO model ran; no device fill/flush, deadline, CPU or memory measurement exists.
gates.reopen: Measure a paced target workload with resource telemetry and separated algorithmic/device delay.

gates.reason: The reference is unregistered and default-OFF; no provider intake, descriptor or ABI decision was made.
gates.reopen: Complete provider intake, a versioned public-surface decision and independent review.

gates.reason: Vendored SpeexDSP source and BSD-3-Clause/KISS notices were pinned and compiled, but no independent rights or upstream-version review was completed.
gates.reopen: Independently review the vendored revision, notices and rights posture for distribution.

gates.reason: Drift was checked only against an exact integer source map; no real capture/playback clock drift was observed.
gates.reopen: Measure independent source/output clocks on the target device and bound drift under load.

gates.reason: No release manifest, Bench bundle, supported-host matrix or publication decision exists.
gates.reopen: Produce a release manifest and a validated Bench bundle on a locked host before any publication.

invariants: No installed v0, public API, C ABI, descriptor, registry, default or CI change.
No C provider, installed target, registration or descriptor is added.
No real corpus, model, weight, room recording, listening panel or device timing.
No pitch-preserving time-stretch claim: this is varispeed only.
No benchmark, publication or release qualification.
No missing or rejected result qualifies a candidate.
